_about.purpose: A realistic sample dataset for designing the statement-import reconciliation UI. Modeled on a real Vietcombank (VND) XLSX statement + the user's ledger. Identifying details (account number, phone, third-party names) are masked. It is CURATED, not a raw dump: the 12 statement rows are chosen so that EVERY review state appears at least once (see reconciliation.rows[].design_note). Amounts are in Vietnamese Dong (₫); the ledger also has SGD accounts to show FX transfers.
_about.how_to_read: statement = what the parser extracted from the file. ledger_now = what's already in the user's ledger for this period. reconciliation = the computed review output the UI renders: per-row band + matched entry + suggested action + off-by + the 3-column projection, plus the not-on-statement panel, the two-question verdict, and the filter-chip counts.
_about.currency_note: ₫ (VND) has no decimals. A card/transfer billed in another currency also carries original_amount/original_currency (see rows with a foreign leg).
